causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Network outages to complete augmentation works on the Heywood Interconnector between Victoria and South Australia materially reduced its capacity.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: While there is in the order of 1200 MW of Semi-scheduled wind installed in South Australia, on the day it was generating below 20 MW, as forecast.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: While two gas generators; Pelican Point Power Station and Torrens Island B3, were unavailable on planned outages the remaining available generating capacity was dispatched.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The impact of these outages was to reduce the capability of the interconnector to deliver power into South Australia.

constraints_named.quote: The V::S_TB_275kV_W_B1 constraint was invoked to manage the outage of the Tailem Bend West bus.

interconnectors_named.name: MurrayLink
interconnectors_named.quote: The MurrayLink interconnector was limited to between 180 MW and 220 MW (its nominal limit).

intervals.quote: On 7 July 2016 at 7.30 pm, the spot price for electricity reached $8879/MWh in South Australia exceeding the $5000/MWh threshold.

network_outages.quote: Network outages to complete augmentation works on the Heywood Interconnector between Victoria and South Australia materially reduced its capacity.
